name: HC33: Non-suppressed ART clients whose repeat VL remained non-suppressed in the reporting quarter
description:
Number of active ART clients with a previous valid non-suppressed viral load who had a repeat VL specimen collected during the reporting period and whose repeat VL result remained non-suppressed.
The patient must have a previous valid non-suppressed VL, must have a later repeat VL sample collection documented in the non-suppressed card during the reporting period, and must have a corresponding valid repeat VL result classified with is_unsuppressed = 1 and is_suppressed = 0; the patient must also satisfy the active-on-ART rule.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT n.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card n
WHERE n.patient_id IS NOT NULL

  /* Repeat VL specimen collected during reporting period */
  AND n.date_of_vl_sample_collection >= :startDate
  AND n.date_of_vl_sample_collection
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  /* Previous valid non-suppressed VL */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode p
      WHERE p.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND p.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND p.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND p.is_suppressed = 0
        AND COALESCE(
              p.sample_collection_date,
              p.viral_load_clinical_date,
              p.laboratory_result_date,
              p.order_date
            ) < n.date_of_vl_sample_collection
  )

  /* Repeat VL result remained non-suppressed */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND v.is_suppressed = 0

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) >= n.date_of_vl_sample_collection

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,

  /* Active on ART */

            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
